question: As of 1 March 2022, which of the following bills were passed in December 2021?

options.text: The Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill, 2021

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Election Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2021**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Election Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2021** was passed in December 2021.
 
• This bill aims to link the electoral roll data with the Aadhaar ecosystem to curb the menace of multiple enrollments of the same person at different places.
 
• It also seeks to make the statutes gender-neutral by substituting the word 'wife' with '
